title: Introduction to Psychology
metaTitle: Psychflix: Introduction to Psychology
metaDescription: Crash Course Psychology host Hank Green introduces psychology, what the field studies, where it came from, and why understanding behaviour and mental processes is more complex than it first appears.

title: Fields of Psychology
metaTitle: Psychflix: Fields of Psychology
metaDescription: A guided overview of the major fields of psychology, explaining how areas such as clinical, developmental, cognitive and social psychology approach different questions about people and behaviour.

title: PSYCHOTHERAPY - Sigmund Freud
metaTitle: Psychflix: PSYCHOTHERAPY - Sigmund Freud
metaDescription: An introduction to Sigmund Freud’s psychoanalytic ideas and his view of the ways unconscious wishes, inner conflict and the pleasure principle shape human experience.

title: Research Methods In Psychology
metaTitle: Psychflix: Research Methods In Psychology
metaDescription: A psychology research-methods lesson covering experiments, correlational studies, surveys, naturalistic observation, case studies and other ways researchers investigate behaviour.

title: Every Mental Disorder & Their Effects Explained
metaTitle: Psychflix: Every Mental Disorder & Their Effects Explained
metaDescription: An accessible overview of mental disorders and the ways psychological conditions can affect everyday thoughts, emotions and behaviour. The video is educational, not a diagnostic guide.

title: Types of Memory
metaTitle: Psychflix: Types of Memory
metaDescription: An introduction to memory as the ability to encode, store and retrieve information, with a look at how memory is connected to the brain and everyday cognition.

title: Theories of Forgetting
metaTitle: Psychflix: Theories of Forgetting
metaDescription: A concise lesson on two explanations of forgetting: decay, in which memory traces may weaken over time, and interference, in which other information makes recall more difficult.

title: Encoding Strategies
metaTitle: Psychflix: Encoding Strategies
metaDescription: A lesson on how information is encoded into memory, including rehearsal, chunking, mnemonic devices, self-reference and spaced practice as ways to support learning and later recall.

title: Memory Strategies: Method of Loci
metaTitle: Psychflix: Memory Strategies: Method of Loci
metaDescription: An explanation of the method of loci, or memory palace: a technique that links information to familiar places and mental images to make ordered information easier to recall.

title: Memory Strategies: Chunking
metaTitle: Psychflix: Memory Strategies: Chunking
metaDescription: An explanation of chunking, the process of grouping separate pieces of information into meaningful units so working memory can handle and remember them more effectively.

title: Difference Between Classical and Operant Conditioning
metaTitle: Psychflix: Difference Between Classical and Operant Conditioning
metaDescription: Peggy Andover explains the difference between classical and operant conditioning: learning through associations between stimuli and learning shaped by consequences such as reinforcement and punishment.

title: Observational Learning
metaTitle: Psychflix: Observational Learning
metaDescription: An introduction to Albert Bandura’s social learning theory and the Bobo doll studies, exploring how people—especially children—can learn by observing other people and their behaviour.

title: General Psychology: Learning
metaTitle: Psychflix: General Psychology: Learning
metaDescription: A broad psychology lesson on learning, introducing how experience changes behaviour and covering major approaches such as classical conditioning, operant conditioning and observational learning.

title: Reinforcement
metaTitle: Psychflix: Reinforcement
metaDescription: An introduction to reinforcement and how consequences can influence the likelihood of behaviour.

title: Dr. B.F. Skinner and Operant Conditioning
metaTitle: Psychflix: Dr. B.F. Skinner and Operant Conditioning
metaDescription: A short introduction to B. F. Skinner’s work on operant conditioning and how consequences, including reinforcement, can influence the likelihood of a behaviour.

title: Ivan Pavlov and Classical Conditioning - Experiment
metaTitle: Psychflix: Ivan Pavlov and Classical Conditioning - Experiment
metaDescription: A brief explanation and re-enactment of Ivan Pavlov’s research, showing how repeated associations between stimuli helped establish the principles of classical conditioning.

title: Bandura and Observational Learning - Experiment
metaTitle: Psychflix: Bandura and Observational Learning - Experiment
metaDescription: A look at Bandura’s observational-learning research and how children can learn behaviours by watching models, a finding central to social learning theory.

title: A typical child on Piaget's conservation tasks
metaTitle: Psychflix: A typical child on Piaget's conservation tasks
metaDescription: A child completes Piagetian conservation tasks involving number, length, liquid, mass and area, illustrating how children’s understanding can be tested across different situations.

title: What Your Handwriting Says About You?
metaTitle: Psychflix: What Your Handwriting Says About You?
metaDescription: A look at popular claims linking handwriting with personality through graphology. These claims are controversial and handwriting analysis is not an established, reliable personality test.

title: 12 Fun and Awesome Psychology Facts You Wish You Knew
metaTitle: Psychflix: 12 Fun and Awesome Psychology Facts You Wish You Knew
metaDescription: A collection of bite-sized psychology ideas about everyday thoughts, feelings and behaviour, presented in an accessible, animated format.

title: World's Quickest Personality Test
metaTitle: Psychflix: World's Quickest Personality Test
metaDescription: A quick personality quiz introducing the Big Five model: openness, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness and neuroticism. Treat it as a brief reflection, not a formal assessment.

title: Are You an Introvert, Extrovert or Ambivert?
metaTitle: Psychflix: Are You an Introvert, Extrovert or Ambivert?
metaDescription: A personality quiz exploring introversion, extroversion and ambiversion, and how social preferences can vary along a spectrum rather than fitting rigid categories.

title: Case Study: CBT Session with Depression
metaTitle: Psychflix: Case Study: CBT Session with Depression
metaDescription: A teaching example of an initial cognitive behavioural therapy session with a client experiencing low mood. It illustrates links between triggers, thoughts, feelings and responses; the client is portrayed by an actor.

title: DSM-5 Real Patient Session - Schizophrenia
metaTitle: Psychflix: DSM-5 Real Patient Session - Schizophrenia
metaDescription: Mental health experts discuss a real clinical case and apply DSM-5 criteria when considering schizophrenia. This is an educational demonstration, not a tool for self-diagnosis.

title: An Actual Therapy Session
metaTitle: Psychflix: An Actual Therapy Session
metaDescription: A therapy-session conversation in which a client explores how earlier experiences have affected their thoughts and emotions, while a therapist helps them consider different perspectives and coping strategies.

title: LIVE Narcissism Therapy Session | Evaluation
metaTitle: Psychflix: LIVE Narcissism Therapy Session | Evaluation
metaDescription: Dr. Ramani Durvasula discusses narcissistic traits and the process of clinical evaluation in a live therapy-style session, offering an educational look at assessment and therapeutic conversation.
